**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go v0.28.1) — `internal/filter/` (`Engine`, `internal/filter/engine.go:13`; `DefaultEngine`, :111; schema at `internal/filter/schema.go`). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled to a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then each driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect{SQLite|Postgres|MySQL}, &where, &args)` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`), and the renderer (`internal/filter/render.go`) emits dialect-specific SQL + bind args that are appended to the query's WHERE clause (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`).

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row plus its comment memo rows), `memo_relation` (rows where the memo is source or target, for the memo and each comment), `attachment` (attachments linked to the memo and its comments) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:566-582`, `store/memo.go:140-158`

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `dist/` bundle is compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22,40-60` (`FrontendService.Serve`, `spaFallbackMiddleware`), wired into the server in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` via `NewFrontendService`/`Serve`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go) — one immediate RunOnce at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker
  (started at server/server.go:161-172; interval const runner.go:26; loop runner.go:29-40)
internal/webhook async dispatch workers (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55) — 4 goroutines started at package init,
  driven by the bounded asyncPostQueue channel (not by a timer)
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron/job scheduler with parser, jobs, middleware) is referenced only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`) — the server never uses it. Also `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` is never instantiated or started; only its helper `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:156` (installed on the transport at :188; a separate interceptor-free `refreshTransport` at :65 avoids recursion). Tokens: a short-lived Bearer access token kept in `localStorage` with expiry (`web/src/auth-state.ts:52-97`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`, refreshed proactively before expiry and reactively on `Unauthenticated` via `AuthService.RefreshToken` (`web/src/connect.ts:74-91,124-150`); the refresh token is a credentialed HTTP cookie (`fetchWithCredentials`, :57-62). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`Authenticator.Authenticate`, `server/auth/authenticator.go:87,159`; `token.go`, `extract.go`), invoked via `NewAuthorizer`/`NewAuthInterceptor` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:68,137` and `server/router/api/v1/authz.go`.

**q30.**
```
memo created:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called memo_service.go:157)
memo updated:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook        — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memo deleted:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook        — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called memo_service.go:562)
memo comment created:  APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three converge on `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` and `:120`.
